Upper Text: While you have a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name and your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, one of your [Agumon] may digivolve into this card in your hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
[When Digivolving] This Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ for the turn. Then, it may attack.
[When Attacking] If you have a Tamer, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn.
